items.name: All Settings Explorer: Export Full SCHEME_CURRENT (/qh)
items.description: Exports raw powercfg /qh output so Falcon can expose every discovered subgroup/setting on this machine.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $out=Join-Path $dir ("power-all-settings-qh-"+$ts+".txt"); powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $out; Write-Output "Saved: $out"

items.name: All Settings Explorer: Export Aliases + Query
items.description: Collects aliases and current effective values to map GUIDs to friendly aliases and verify current values.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $a=Join-Path $dir ("power-aliases-"+$ts+".txt"); $q=Join-Path $dir ("power-query-"+$ts+".txt"); powercfg /aliases | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $a; powercfg /query | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $q; Write-Output "Saved: $a"; Write-Output "Saved: $q"

items.name: All Settings Explorer: Build Parsed JSON Catalog
items.description: Parses powercfg /qh output into JSON with subgroup GUID/alias, setting GUID/alias, AC/DC values, units and enum candidates.

steps.command: $raw = powercfg /qh SCHEME_CURRENT | Out-String; $lines=$raw -split "`r?`n"; $rows=@(); $sub=''; $set=''; foreach($line in $lines){ if($line -match '^\s*Subgroup GUID:\s*([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})\s*\((.+)\)'){ $sub=$Matches[1]+'|'+$Matches[2] }; if($line -match '^\s*Power Setting GUID:\s*([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})\s*\((.+)\)'){ $set=$Matches[1]+'|'+$Matches[2] }; if($line -match '^\s*Current AC Power Setting Index:\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)'){ $ac=$Matches[1] }; if($line -match '^\s*Current DC Power Setting Index:\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)'){ $dc=$Matches[1]; if($sub -and $set){ $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ subgroup=$sub; setting=$set; ac=$ac; dc=$dc }; $ac=$null; $dc=$null } } }; $ts=Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir | Out-Null }; $out=Join-Path $dir ("power-settings-catalog-"+$ts+".json"); $rows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $out; Write-Output "Saved: $out"
